description: Process A opens the fixture shared read/write through Workspaces(0), inserted 100 rows with INSERT ... SELECT (index maintenance on N), signals and is terminated by TerminateProcess without any release or Close. After 1.5 s, process B keeps the database and lock-file bytes (frozen before any opener) and reads the lock file natively; then process B opens the database with DAO (shared read/write), reads the counts, the ten updated rows and row 1, and closes. Process-termination model only (live OS cache).
retentionNote: Designed r-crash-1-kill probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
